theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_pointwise
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsSlice T f t S → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ LW : ℝ≥0, (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ W → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖₊ ≤ LW) → S.massOn W ≤ (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => μ (W ∩ f ⁻¹' Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0)
